work_completed: Researched before implementing (owner's order): Avalonia Android insets/InputPane/IME issues, Numa's device-learned keyboard rule, Godot Android editor and mobile code editor feedback, Unexpected Keyboard swipe model; recorded in apps/lunet2d/docs/research/casca-android-avalonia-2026-11-25.md.
Added the Android head 'Lunet Nova' (src/Lunet.Shell.Android, io.lunet.studio.shell) hosting LunetShell, signed with the stable development key, installable next to io.lunet.studio.
Added KeyboardFit (cover only edge-to-edge windows, 220 ms close grace) wired to InputPane/InsetsManager; tabs and bottom sheet step aside while typing.
Added the swipe code bar (CodeKeys/CodeKeyBar): 10 keys of 48 dp, ~30 symbols, structural brace block, pairs, arrows and Tab as single edits.
Release pipeline builds, verifies and attaches Lunet-Nova-<version>-arm64.apk; the emulator stage installs it on Android 13, measures cold start and runs a game created and compiled inside the shell.
